definitions.explanation: The time or circumstance when something happens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帰国|きこく}→帰国：03025_kikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|さい}
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{際|さい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact me on that occasion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込|もうしこ}み→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|さい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{持参|じさん}→持参：00127_jisan⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{際|さい} indicates an occasion or timing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|さい} (when ~, on the occasion of ~)
- 〜た{際|さい}(は) (when [past event])
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{際|さい} (at this point, while we're at it)
- ⟦いざ→いざ：noentry⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{際|さい} (in case of emergency)

REGISTER:
- {際|さい} is formal/written style
- ⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧ is the neutral equivalent

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧: when (general)
- {際|さい}: occasion (formal)
- ⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: case, situation
